issue_request: FHIR-15687 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for FHIR-core ConceptMap. Its final resolution required adding ConceptMap.group.element.valueSet, ConceptMap.group.element.target.valueSet, and ConceptMap.group.unmapped.valueSet as canonical(ValueSet) elements with cardinality 0..1.

additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-33061 was the usage-note follow-up created from FHIR-15687, and the current introduction contains the expected ValueSet expansion semantics. FHIR-40598 later clarified the ValueSet reference definitions and unmapped behavior without reversing the FHIR-15687 design.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch.
